name: superreview
description: AI PR review loop: commit intent trailers, a deterministic reading map, and a context-free reader that gates gh pr create until the PR is self-sustaining

maxRounds.title: Max rounds
maxRounds.description: Reader rounds before the loop stops and asks the prompter

maxBodyChars.title: Max body length
maxBodyChars.description: Hard limit, in characters, for the part of the PR body the agent writes

intentModel.title: Intent model
intentModel.description: Model that summarizes the human messages into the Intent trailer

signingKey.title: Signing key
signingKey.description: SSH key file (private, or its .pub with the key in ssh-agent) that signs the marker. Empty: git's user.signingkey when gpg.format is ssh. No key: the marker is not signed
